rendered: The sodiation of the carbon layer provides 0.05 mAh/cm^2[1] (or 120 mAh/g[2]). The paper calls this negligible compared with the plating capacities, which reach up to 12 mAh/cm^2[3], as shown in Fig. 1[4] (panel a, where the sodiation step is labelled with the sodiation capacity and the Na growth step with the plating capacity). The plating capacity is therefore far larger than the sodiation capacity.
